EWY holding above its rising SMA20
against: RRP buffer at $0.20B — no more slack to cushion TGA rebuilds
Samsung -8.70% and SK Hynix -3.41% — sharp single-day air pocket in the Korea chain thesis
KOSPI still 1,500 points below the 8,200 gate threshold

counterargs.read: The tape is still constructive — credit is calm, Korea's FX and technical conditions pass, and volatility is low in absolute terms — but today's session shows the easing impulse losing momentum rather than extending. Samsung's -8.70% drop is the single loudest signal in the data and is large enough to be idiosyncratic (earnings/guidance) rather than macro, but it is a reminder that the Korea leg of the thesis is single-stock concentrated. With RRP now near zero, the liquidity buffer that has cushioned TGA rebuilds since spring is gone, which raises the stakes of the Aug 27 H.4.1 print.
